claims.claim: The southern Ainsel entrance follows Ainsel River Well Depths, Ainsel River Sluice Gate, Ainsel River Downstream and the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella; this branch cannot continue through the waterfall into the northern Ainsel/Ranni route.
The northern Ranni branch reaches Nokstella Waterfall Basin, then the Baleful Shadow encounter, and only after that does the lift route open toward Lake of Rot.

notes: Southern Ainsel and northern Ainsel/Ranni are modeled as separate connected components with explicit endpoint and quest-state behavior.
No game process, save, archive, memory or original XYZ coordinate was accessed.
